adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff introduces `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` and then directly applies them: `group.users.order(:username_lower).limit(limit).offset(offset)`. There is no upper bound on `limit`, so a request like `?limit=1000000` will attempt to load/serialize an extremely large membership list, creating a clear performance/DoS risk. There is also no non-negative guard; a negative `offset` will be passed through to SQL (`OFFSET -1`), which can raise a Postgres error and produce a 500. The change also applies this logic to all groups (previously pagination was only applied to automatic groups), increasing the exposure of these edge cases.
